implementation.command_options: Mode/Prongs/Profile/ProfileSave/Rails/Height/Drop/SeatDepth + four edit levels; basket prongs and gallery rails on the gem girdle

manual_gate.open: preview/commit/cancel of Head Builder Basket on the OpenMatrix9 window

limitations: The default head drop follows the stone (35% of the pavilion depth, capped at 0.9 mm) so the base stays above the culet.
Prong clearance is measured against the inscribed girdle radius; a faceted outline is inscribed in its profile circle.
A selection without a gem object is refused: the builder consumes the gem owner's om9.gem record.
